text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rob Roy! Perfect timing.
You're joining me for lunch right now!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sweep-san! Yes, gladly...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, would it be alright
if I invited Trainer as well...?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That was the plan all along. It'd just be a hassle with only the two of us, right?
Like getting mistaken for kids and turned away at the door! Hmph.
choice_data_list: Well then, maybe I'll eat together with you.

text_block_list.text:
Led along by Sweep Tosho,
we arrived at a family restaurant, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you doing?
Hurry up and get in.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, um... the automatic doors won't open...
It's always like this...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course that's not it!
Jeez, just move aside a bit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Look, it opened right up, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Welcome~! A party of two, right?
I'll show you to your seats!

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Will the remaining guest be joining you later?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Umm... I'm right here.
There's one more person..."

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I am so sorry!
Please forgive my terrible rudeness...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I think I'll go with
the Carrot Hamburg Steak...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too—wait,
the side dish is bell peppers?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, whatever.
I'll take the Carrot Hamburg Steak too!"
choice_data_list: I'll have the same thing as you.
I'll have the same thing, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'll call the waiter...
Okay...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ex-Excuse me... ......

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...No one is reacting, are they...?
It's always like this..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Automatic doors wouldn't open for me, people would leave me out of headcounts...
It was like nobody noticed me at all...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're overthinking it! Your voice was just too quiet, that's all!
Come on, say it properly one more time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
I'm so sooorryyy...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Project more from your diaphragm!
The shop is lively, so no one's gonna
hear you like that. Come on, together now!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ex-Excuse meeeeeee...!!

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text: Right away, comiiing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: See? You can do it when you try!

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Ready to order! Today, we highly recommend
our new menu item, the 'Dublin-Style Doria'.
How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Um... Uhm...
Err...

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
It has been extremely well received by our other patrons as well,
so if you would like, please give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... then, I will go with—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's not it!
Three 'Carrot Hamburg Steaks', please!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And another thing, swap out the bell pepper garnish for something else!
I don't wanna eat it!

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text: Certainly! That'll be three Carrot Hamburgers, with one side dish swapped—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Phew~ That was delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san really is amazing...!
She speaks her mind without being swayed by others!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, I'm...
they don't even notice me..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I know I can't stay like this.
I want to change...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I even managed to call the waiter over...! 
I want to try even harder...!
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's take our time and move forward slowly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
Does this mean I've taken a step forward...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I... will keep challenging myself...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Rob Roy!
You're going to become a hero who stands alongside the witch, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes...! I'll do my best
to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Sweep-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes...! You're right!
Even if it's slow, step by step,
I have to keep moving forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit!
Don't let yourself get intimidated!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Next time in the library,
let's see if there's any magic that grants courage♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes...!
Thank you so much...!"
